exposure: early pregnancy maternal total homocysteine (tHcy) concentrations
early pregnancy maternal total vitamin B12 concentrations
early pregnancy maternal active vitamin B12 concentrations
umbilical cord total vitamin B12 concentrations
umbilical cord active vitamin B12 concentrations
outcome: fetal growth parameters (measured repeatedly in pregnancy by ultrasound)
cohort: The study included 5890 pregnant women participating in a population-based prospective cohort study.
finding: High early pregnancy maternal tHcy and low early pregnancy maternal folate were associated with reduced weight growth patterns and lower birthweight, while low umbilical cord folate was associated with lower birthweight and birth length; interestingly, lower umbilical cord vitamin B12 was associated with higher weight, length, and head circumference at birth.
